description: The director asks a verifier seat to run one verifier's command on a snapshot of the stage (D45).

verify.description: This request's id, quoted back in the verdict.
verify.title: Verify

command.description: The command to run, exactly as given.
command.title: Command

timeout.description: A duration in whole seconds, as a decimal string, e.g. "30".
timeout.title: Timeout

marker.description: The stage's change marker when the director sent it.
marker.title: Marker

files.description: The script's check files the command runs, by their path in the script's package (D55); the seat writes them into a fresh folder, which the command finds as ${ZANNI_SCRIPT}.
files.title: Files

title: Verify
